Class ChinaMirrorService

java.lang.Object
dev.copperbench.network.ChinaMirrorService
public final class ChinaMirrorService extends Object
Configures Gradle distribution and Maven repository mirrors for networks in mainland China. Gradle wrapper downloads happen before init scripts, so the wrapper URL must be rewritten too.
